preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 100 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of SWAG Traits n is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == ki + 1 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for ki in [int(line.split()[0])])
preconditions.description: Each SWAG Trait line has exactly ki + 1 integers (ki followed by ki elements).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 1000 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for x in line.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each element in the SWAG Traits is a positive integer between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: For each test case, stdout contains two space-separated integers: the optimal Swag Level of RK and RG.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= rk <= sum(sum(int(x) for x in line.split()[1:]) for line in test_case_lines) for rk, rg in [map(int, line.split()) for line in stdout.strip().split()])
postconditions.description: For each test case, the sum of RK's and RG's Swag Levels equals the total sum of all elements in the SWAG Traits.

postconditions.expression: all(rk >= 0 and rg >= 0 for rk, rg in [map(int, line.split()) for line in stdout.strip().split()])
postconditions.description: Both RK's and RG's Swag Levels are non-negative integers.
